The feature is a **Delete bill** action for bills in `PENDING` status. It was added by PR #717, "(feat) Add delete action for pending bills", merged as commit `db22701b`. No ticket is linked to it.

- **What it does:** the user picks a bill from the bill-history overflow menu or the Invoice page, confirms in a modal, and the app calls `DELETE /bill/{uuid}?reason=...`. The bill is not voided. The PR description and a reviewer comment say the backend's `voidBill` validates the reason but only saves the unchanged bill, so no void fields are set.
- **Which bills:** only `PENDING` bills. The overflow menu shows the item only when `isPending` is true ([bill-action-menu.component.tsx:17](openmrs-esm-billing-app/src/bill-history/bill-action-menu.component.tsx)), and the Invoice page shows its button only when `bill?.status === BillStatus.PENDING` ([invoice.component.tsx:252](openmrs-esm-billing-app/src/invoice/invoice.component.tsx)).
- **Where it is offered:** the bill-history overflow menu (bill list) and the Invoice page action bar. On success, the bill list refreshes, or the Invoice page navigates back to `home/billing`.
- **What the user supplies:** a required reason, entered in a text area labelled "Reason for deletion" (max 255 characters). The Delete button stays disabled until the reason is non-empty ([delete-bill-confirmation.modal.tsx:86](openmrs-esm-billing-app/src/modal/delete-bill-confirmation.modal.tsx)).

Neither the PR, its commit, nor the code mentions abandoned visits, so that link is my inference from "pending" meaning unpaid. The ticket is not recorded anywhere I could search: the PR has no linked tickets, its title and body have no key, and Falkon's ticket lookup returned nothing for this commit. The ticket field is therefore left out of the array.
